chunks.heading: about
chunks.text: ## Who I am I am Zaid Haris, a second-year BEng Robotics, Mechatronics and Control Engineering student at Loughborough University. I am interested in robotics, mechatronics and AI. ## Where I am based I am based in Leicester, UK, and I study at Loughborough University. ## Education I started at Loughborough in 2025. My Year 1 modules included Applied Engineering, Core Maths, Dynamic Systems Analysis, and Programming and Software Engineering. My Year 2 modules include Control System Design, Robotic Systems Technology, and Project Design and Management.

chunks.heading: projects
chunks.text: ## Autonomous EV Charging Robot (group coursework, simulation) I led design engineering and project management for a team of 6 on a simulated EV charging robot with an arm, LiDAR and computer vision. We identified 9 failure modes, with a mitigation for each. I chose the actuators and motors and worked with my teammates to fit them into the team's CAD. ## Adaptive Low-Power Temperature Monitor (Arduino, individual coursework) I built an Arduino data logger that adjusts its sampling rate using an on-board DFT and the Nyquist criterion.
